author: bardic-inspiration
name: Widow Rapier
summary: A slender rapier whose wounds spread numbing venom.
description: A thin black line runs the length of the blade and wanders slowly like a vein. Its former owners seldom die of old age.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with it, the target takes an extra 1d6 Poison damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the end of your next turn.
